# Giverny: Claude Skills Directory (full)

> 10,838 Claude skills from 316 GitHub repos, grouped by section and category. Updated 2026-11-28. Each link opens a page with what the skill does and how to install it.

## Claude Skills for Design and UI (1,172)

Claude design skills teach Claude to build interfaces with real taste: a committed aesthetic instead of a template, solid design systems, motion that feels hand-made, accessibility checks, and platform rules for iOS, Android and the web. Use them in Claude Code whenever you build or polish UI.

## Claude Code Skills for Developers (6,178)

Claude Code skills for developers add proven engineering workflows (planning, test-driven development, debugging, code review) and deep knowledge of specific stacks: security audits, performance, authentication, databases, cloud and mobile. Many come straight from the teams behind the tools, like Stripe, Supabase, Cloudflare, Sentry and Vercel.
